note: Intentionally lossy: the embedded credential carries only the bare VC 2.0 context, so per spec its `Individual` subject type (a relative IRI) and the undefined `fullName` term are DROPPED after the `@context: null` isolation on `verifiableCredential`. The golden pins the conformant (jsonld.js) output; safe mode must be off to generate it. Guards the removal of the documentBase fallback in Expansion::activateTypeScopedContexts(), which wrongly resurrects the presentation-level type-scoped context inside the isolated credential.
